official_airborne_rule.fact: Acrobats Dodge can now be activated while airborne.

implementation: Acrobat reference selects its own class energy account and mode-specific baseline through the shared class_regeneration profile. Gain uses .5 CES and shared class_gain; clearing selection pauses this retained account, following the existing Gambler reference policy.

The native cast captures one entity life and filtered held input, then issues additive horizontal and vertical impulses. Neutral input uses an explicitly calibrated signed horizontal facing fallback; missing input does not fabricate a direction.

A detached completion waits for its required calibrated delay, resolves the original life and only continues if alive. It survives unequip/input changes and pure-domain checkpoint restore; it does not claim physical-world restart recovery.

Shared benefit applies existing Radiant through per-recipient solar_effect_duration and authorization. Self and allies use ten meters; enemies use 6.5 meters, target classification and an externally supplied falloff / world damage scale. Radiant authorization denial is local; unknown observations halt without replay.

Ascension emits chorus_d2:ascension_dodge_benefits only inside its observed-displacement branch. The selected Acrobat source matches the emitted accepted ability and cost_ability references, schedules a same-life completion and invokes the same benefit bundle without leap, second cost or second ability use.

Ascension blast transfer is an explicit calibration profile: the default synthetic test transfers Radiant only; the alternate unit fixture transfers the Solar blast while preserving Ascension credit. Neither is asserted to be the current Destiny behavior.
explicit_unverified_policies: Modern airborne completion timing is unresolved. Required completion_delay represents a calibrated animation-phase policy in these reference tests, not proof that physical terrain contact is or is not required.

Synthetic impulses are 6 m/s horizontal plus 4 m/s upward, idle direction is backward and completion delay is .2 s. No original animation, displacement curve, friction compensation, velocity replacement or client prediction has been measured.

Synthetic blast falloff is linear from full at zero to zero at 6.5 meters, with .1 damage-unit projection. Public peak/radius values do not establish this curve or world conversion. Damage classification follows combatant / Guardian targets independently of the mode-specific cooldown.

Completion selects targets around the caster current feet, without line of sight, in stable identity order. Source-side damage is evaluated when the blast executes. Precise original query anchors, sight rules, snapshot timing and damage / Radiant ordering need verification.
Ascension shared delay .2 s and whether its selected dodge transfers the Solar explosion remain unverified. The event is a Chorus content extension point, not a newly claimed Bungie lifecycle event.

Class regeneration stat curve and any Acrobat-specific damage scaling above 100 Class are not inferred from Ascension. Full exotics/fragments/mod interactions, animation, formal subclass assembly, HUD, assets and physical-world persistence remain incomplete.
